Method of Attack: Phishing attack using HTML forms stored on IPFS and served via Cloudflare's IPFS gateway secured by SSL certificates to appear legitimate
Phishing form submission to attacker-controlled page
Attack Vector: Phishing URLs related to searchurl.bid domain
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing form submission pages on URLs related to searchurl.bid
Use of Cloudflare IPFS gateway URLs serving phishing HTML
